label: По
description: The preposition по + dative: motion along a surface, channels (по телефону), and regularity (по утрам).

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Motion along a surface. 1. 'Иду' is on-foot motion. 2. 'По улице' is dative and means along the street. 3. A core motion-along-a-path pattern.
Strategic focus: Strolling over an area. 1. 'Гуляю' is leisurely motion. 2. 'По парку' is dative and means around the park. 3. По covers movement spread over a space.

missions.phrase: По дороге домой я купил хлеб.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Along a route. 1. 'По дороге' is dative and means along the road. 2. 'Домой' marks the direction home. 3. A set phrase for things done on the way.

missions.phrase: Мы едем по городу на машине.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Vehicle motion over an area. 1. 'Едем' is travel by vehicle. 2. 'По городу' is dative and means around the city. 3. По marks movement covering the whole space.
Strategic focus: Pacing within a space. 1. 'Ходит' is repeated walking. 2. 'По комнате' is dative and means around the room. 3. По expresses motion back and forth over a surface.
Strategic focus: Crossing along a surface. 1. 'Идём' is on-foot motion. 2. 'По мосту' is dative and means across the bridge. 3. По names the surface the motion follows.
Strategic focus: Channel of communication. 1. 'Говорим' is speaking. 2. 'По телефону' is dative and names the means: by phone. 3. По marks the channel an action travels through.
Strategic focus: Means of broadcast. 1. 'Слушаю' is listening. 2. 'По радио' is dative and means on the radio. 3. По names the medium carrying the signal.
Strategic focus: Channel of delivery. 1. 'Письмо' is the letter. 2. 'По почте' is dative and means by mail. 3. По marks the means by which something is sent.
Strategic focus: Means of contact. 1. 'Общаемся' is communicating. 2. 'По интернету' is dative and means over the internet. 3. По names the channel the message travels through.
Strategic focus: Regular timing. 1. 'Пью' is drinking. 2. 'По утрам' is dative plural and means in the mornings. 3. По with time expresses a repeated habit.

missions.phrase: По вечерам мы гуляем в парке.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Recurring schedule. 1. 'Гуляем' is strolling. 2. 'По вечерам' is dative plural and means in the evenings. 3. По marks an action done regularly at that time.

missions.phrase: По понедельникам я хожу в спортзал.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Weekly regularity. 1. 'Хожу' is going. 2. 'По понедельникам' is dative plural and means on Mondays. 3. По with weekdays signals a repeating routine.
Strategic focus: According to a guide. 1. 'Работаю' is the action. 2. 'По плану' is dative and means according to plan. 3. По marks the standard an action conforms to.
Strategic focus: Conforming to rules. 1. 'Играем' is playing. 2. 'По правилам' is dative plural and means by the rules. 3. По names the norms the action follows.
